acceptance_criteria: No unsafe lease takeover/recreate; precise prepared/inflight/created CAS, owned-marker recovery and uncertainty, explicit provider limits and meaningful tests; no tools or claims.
task.objective: No tools. Correct S35 advice within <=1200 words. Durable state machine is prepared -> inflight -> created with operationId/fingerprint stored before external call. Only CAS prepared->inflight winner may call create. Once inflight exists, expiry/crash alone NEVER permits a second create; lookup may recover a bot-authenticated marker receipt, otherwise return uncertain. A strongly consistent empty lookup still does not rule out an old in-flight request landing later. Only actually-proven durable provider idempotency can allow resubmission of the SAME operationId. Preserve capability gap explicitly; do not accept orphan detection as no-duplicate prevention. Provider adapter/live evidence stays future row; synthetic backend tests are S only. Return precise interfaces/tests and remaining impossible-to-infer outcomes for this design, no tools or changes.
